summary: Verified iter21 config-edit-stops behavior. Backend: PUT /api/automation/config forces enabled=false and calls automation_engine.stop(akey) — confirmed via test_iter21_config_edit_stops.py (2/2 passed). Full pytest regression: 197 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed (parallel -n auto). Frontend /dashboard/config loads without console errors, amber warning banner (data-testid=config-edit-warning) renders with correct copy, Save (data-testid=save-config) sends PUT with enabled=false, response returns enabled=false, and success toast shows STOP message ('Konfigurasi tersimpan. Automation dalam kondisi STOP — tekan Start untuk menjalankan.'). Mount-time POST /automation/stop path was not triggered because the fetched config was already enabled=false (as designed — backend force-stops on prior save), which is consistent with the guarantee.
critical_code_review_comments: Configuration.jsx is ~600 lines — consider splitting Section/Field forms into subcomponents for maintainability.

PUT /api/automation/config forces enabled=false, but the Auto-Start UI Switch (data-testid=switch-enabled) still lets the user toggle enabled=true locally; on Save it's silently overridden. Consider disabling that Switch or hiding it on the Configuration page to avoid operator confusion (Start should be triggered from the Status page).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter21 (config edit force-stop) fully verified. Backend test suite green at 197 passed under -n auto (no flakes observed). Frontend save flow verified with real network interception on Configuration page.
